mechanism: Senna's cathartic effects may cause electrolyte depletion and dehydration, which increases risk of hypertensive crisis and arrhythmias in patients on tranylcypromine (MAOI), particularly through sodium depletion affecting sympathomimetic sensitivity.
action: Monitor electrolytes closely if senna use is necessary; prefer gentler laxatives (psyllium, docusate) and ensure adequate hydration; counsel patient on dietary tyramine restriction while on tranylcypromine.
